trigger: MessageBox. First-run setup; one-time.
draft_prose: Title: "Which Tradition" Body: "Breton faith is the tradition you walk; the gods give it shape after. Choose: the Knight's Road of vow and mercy, the Hidden Art of occult practice, or the Green Way of the old druidic covenant."

trigger: HUD corner notification. On tradition set to Knight's Road.
draft_prose: You walk the Knight's Road. The vow is yours to keep.

trigger: HUD corner notification. On tradition set to Hidden Art.
draft_prose: You walk the Hidden Art. The occult practice is yours, and its risks.

trigger: HUD corner notification. On tradition set to Green Way.
draft_prose: You walk the Green Way. The old druidic covenant is yours.

trigger: HUD corner notification. Fires when focused emphasis settles within the tradition; %s deity.
draft_prose: Within your tradition, your devotion has settled on %s. The focus has emerged.

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Knight's Road Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "The Vow Unbroken" Body: "Skyrim offered you the Guild, the Brotherhood, every expedient shortcut -- and you kept the vow through all of it. That is the hardest road in this province. The shield you carry for others is real now."

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Hidden Art Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "The Double Life Resolved" Body: "You chose -- the practice hidden completely, or declared and Notorious. You did not linger in the safe middle. Your patron rewards the one who commits, whichever way. The art is fully yours."

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Green Way Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "The Forest Knows You" Body: "Skyrim's woods are cold and they do not welcome easily. They welcome you. The animals settle, the hunt is guided, the standing stones answer. The old covenant is kept, quietly and completely."

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per band entry.
draft_prose: Your knightly vow stands intact. Stendarr reads it clearly.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per band entry.
draft_prose: Your knightly vow is strained. Knight's Road favor comes harder now.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per band entry.
draft_prose: Your knightly vow is broken. The Knight's Road halts until you restore it.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per band entry.
draft_prose: Your occult practice is Hidden. It is invisible to those who would object.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per band entry.
draft_prose: Your practice is Suspected. The Vigilants may begin to notice.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per band entry.
draft_prose: Your practice is Known. The Vigilants are a real danger now.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per band entry.
draft_prose: Practice now Notorious. Society ruptures; the patron rewards full commitment.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per band entry.
draft_prose: The druidic covenant is open but unproven. Y'ffre waits.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per band entry.
draft_prose: The druidic covenant is acknowledged. Y'ffre answers you steadily.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per band entry.
draft_prose: The druidic covenant frays. The forest is forgetting you.

trigger: MessageBox. One-time, on first werewolf transformation as Green Way.
draft_prose: Title: "The Druidic Trial" Body: "The beast is in you now. The druid circles have always been split on this. Decide: the beast serves the Green, and the covenant deepens around the new shape -- or Hircine's gift becomes your own, and the Green closes to you. Choose."

trigger: MessageBox. Y'ffre devotion resumes full; Hircine path locked out.
draft_prose: The beast serves the Green.

trigger: MessageBox. Druidic fork betrayal pressure begins; Hircine drift begins.
draft_prose: Hircine's gift is mine.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per lapse-band crossing.
draft_prose: You went Notorious, then stopped. The cost remains; the reward is gone.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per lapse-band crossing.
draft_prose: The forest stopped noticing you. Nature is only background now.

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first reaching Notorious.
draft_prose: Title: "Notorious" Body: "You have stopped hiding. Society recoils, and there is no taking it back -- but I no longer have to whisper to you. The art is loud now, and it is fully yours."

trigger: HUD corner notification. Environmental; per stone, first visit.
draft_prose: At the standing stone, the old covenant answers.

trigger: HUD corner notification. Environmental; cadence-based, daily cap.
draft_prose: The wild keeps you. Y'ffre's covenant is steady.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; nature-aligned restraint.
draft_prose: You spared the living world where you could. Counted.

trigger: MessageBox. Once on becoming vampire.
draft_prose: Title: "The Curse and the Tradition" Body: "You are undead now, and each tradition answers differently. The Knight's Road breaks -- oaths and Divines lost. The Green Way excommunicates -- Y'ffre closes. Only the Hidden Art finds you a partial home, in the Volkihar court and the witch-mother's acceptance."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on cure.
draft_prose: Title: "Re-Entry" Body: "The undeath is lifted. The Knight's Road may be rebuilt through restored Integrity. The Green Way remains under betrayal pressure until an authored re-entry exists; richer restoration is deferred."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on first transformation; Knight's Road.
draft_prose: Title: "Homeless in the Vow" Body: "The beast is in you, and the Knight's Road has no frame for it. There is no theological home for the wolf here. Your Integrity degrades on each transformation, and the knightly orders will not understand."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on first transformation; Hidden Art.
draft_prose: Title: "The Beast Belongs" Body: "The beast is in you, and the Hidden Art already holds Hircine. Glenmoril is family here. There is no rupture -- the wolf fits the occult frame as though it were always meant to."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on werewolf cure; per-tradition resolution.
draft_prose: Title: "The Beast Set Down" Body: "The wolf is set down. On the Knight's Road, Integrity may now be rebuilt, the transformations ended, though the orders remember. In the Hidden Art the beast that belonged is given up by choice; Glenmoril marks the loss, and the occult frame holds an empty place."

trigger: Dialogue topic; Knight's Road, Faithful or above.
draft_prose: "I keep the knightly vow for Stendarr. Where is mercy needed?"

trigger: Dialogue topic; Hidden Art tradition.
draft_prose: "I practice the hidden art. Speak plainly -- no one is listening."

trigger: Dialogue topic; Green Way tradition.
draft_prose: "The Green Way is mine. Tell me of the standing stones here."

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on entering the Known exposure band.
draft_prose: Title: "A Letter from the Vigil" Body: "A sealed letter finds you, unsigned but unmistakable. The Vigilants of Stendarr have heard what you keep, and they are watching the roads you take. It is a warning, this time. They do not send a second."

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on continued Known-band visibility after the Letter.
draft_prose: Title: "The Vigil on the Road" Body: "Two Vigilants block the road ahead, hands near their maces, reading you for the mark of the thing you serve. They ask their questions knowing the answers. How this ends depends on what they decide they saw -- and on whether your cover holds one more time."

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on entering the Notorious exposure band.
draft_prose: Title: "The Vigil Comes for You" Body: "The watching is over. The Vigilants have named you a servant of the Daedra, and they have come in number to end it. There is no letter now, no question, no road to slip down. What you practiced in the dark has found you in the light, and only one of you walks away."
